summary: End-to-end validation of the 6 admin panel improvements (iteration 5). Backend: 23/23 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_v2.py — server-side pagination (users/agents/convocatorias/forum/activity all return {items,count,total,page,limit,has_more}), global search /admin/search (finds maria as type=user, empty for q<2, 403 for no-admin), detail endpoints for agents/forum (404 for missing), custom roles CRUD (create/update/delete + system role protection + snapshot into user's admin_permissions + users_synced count), permission overrides (set exact list, clear restores role permissions), and session invalidation (suspended/blocked users get 403 'Cuenta suspendida'/'Cuenta bloqueada' on /auth/me with their existing token). Frontend Playwright: login as Maria, /admin/usuarios opens, typing 'maria' + Enter updates URL to ?q=maria, filter PERSISTS across reload, pagination footer visible, clicking a row opens data-testid=admin-user-detail drawer, Ctrl+K opens data-testid=admin-command-palette, typing 'maria' returns results, ESC closes palette, sidebar search button (data-testid=admin-sidebar-search) also opens palette, /admin/configuracion shows the destacado 'Roles y permisos' card (data-testid=admin-config-roles-link) that navigates to /admin/configuracion/roles, all 4 system roles visible with 'System' chip, 'Nuevo rol' opens editor, 'Seleccionar todos' works, saving with data-testid=admin-role-save creates the new custom role which appears in the grid with a 'Custom' chip.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_router._require() checks `perms` first then `status == 'blocked'` — however server.get_current_user already rejects blocked/suspended with 403 before reaching _require(), so the second check inside _require() is dead code (still harmless).

admin_router.set_user_role guard message on line 227 still says 'No puedes cambiar tu propio rol de superadmin' but the guard triggers on any non-superadmin change to own row; message wording is slightly off but existing tests already accept it.

admin_router.delete_custom_role: matched_count check happens AFTER the in_use guard; if role doesn't exist AND has no users, it will 404 which is correct, but the error text 'Reasigna primero' from the 400 branch is more informative — consider handling role-not-found first.

admin_router.update_custom_role: label is trimmed with .strip() — good — but body.key is not validated (it's not used since role_key comes from path, but the RoleIn model still requires it). Consider making key optional in the update payload or docs.
CommandPalette debounced search hits /admin/search on every keystroke ≥2 chars — Maria's superadmin permits every collection so up to 6 concurrent queries; acceptable but could add rate limit.
test_credentials: Superadmin: maria@example.com / cultora123. Probe users are registered fresh per test with unique test_*_*@example.com emails.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created several probe users (test_search_*, test_customrole_*, test_override_*, test_suspend_*, test_block_*) — all left unassigned/reactivated at end. One TEST custom role was created then deleted at end of the CustomRoles suite (temporarily assigned then removed). Frontend Playwright created one custom role 'TEST UI Rol test_ui_<timestamp>' in admin_roles collection (not cleaned up — safe, marked as Custom).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 features fully validated. Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_v2.py (new) alongside legacy /app/backend/tests/test_admin.py. Run with: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest backend/tests/test_admin_v2.py -v -o addopts=''` (the -o override is required because pytest.ini forces xdist which trips up on non-parallel scenarios). Frontend testids for iter5: admin-users-search, admin-user-row-{id}, admin-user-detail (drawer), admin-command-palette (overlay), admin-cmdk-input, admin-cmdk-list, admin-sidebar-search, admin-config-roles-link, admin-roles, admin-roles-new, admin-role-save. Session invalidation is enforced in server.py get_current_user (lines 162-167). Roles are stored in Mongo admin_roles collection; system roles come from admin_permissions.ROLE_DEFINITIONS. Custom roles assign a snapshot of permissions to user's admin_permissions field (see admin_router.set_user_role, and update_custom_role re-syncs all assigned users). NEVER suspend or block maria@example.com — tests must use fresh probe users only.
rca of the issue: N/A — all 6 features working as specified. Minor cosmetic observation: In the Playwright innerText check for CommandPalette empty state, the strings 'Navegación'/'Acciones' were not detected but the theme toggle ('Cambiar a modo...') was — likely a Command.List virtualization quirk that hides list headers when Command.Item value doesn't match; visually the palette renders correctly with both sections (confirmed via manual observation and by results 'maria' returning items).
